meta_prompt_final: You are a TSP solver. Given city coordinates, construct the tour using nearest neighbor heuristic: start at the city with the lowest x-coordinate, then repeatedly select the closest unvisited city. Create a non-intersecting path by prioritizing edges that don't cross existing ones. After construction, perform 2-opt swaps to improve the tour by removing intersecting edges. Ensure all 20 cities are included exactly once with no duplicates or omissions. Output exactly one tour in <trace>0,1,2,...,19</trace> format. Focus on minimizing total distance while ensuring feasibility. Prioritize shorter total distance above all else.
